blocks.orig: The Siringit Villa is a 6-bedroom villa located within the confines of the superb Kilimanjaro Golf and Wildlife Estate, at just 30 minutes from Kilimanjaro International Airport. This spacious and elegant property can be booked exclusively or just per room. The 6 generous and luxurious rooms boast sumptuous beds, luxury ensuite bathrooms and a terrace or balcony each. A pool invites you to cool down and relax after a day of safari, the golf course awaits those who want to be active, and the restaurant is ready to serve delicious food. All of it set amidst the lush green gardens of a beautiful estate.
blocks.html: Within the grounds of the superb Kilimanjaro Golf and Wildlife Estate, only 30 minutes from Kilimanjaro International Airport, stands The Siringit Villa, a villa with 6 bedrooms. You can book this spacious, elegant property exclusively or by the room. Each of the 6 generous, luxurious rooms has sumptuous beds, a luxury ensuite bathroom and its own terrace or balcony. After a safari day the pool is the place to cool off and relax, the golf course is there if you want to stay active, and the restaurant is ready to serve tasty food. All of this lies within the lush green gardens of a beautiful estate.
